content_of_post_to_comment: You can be excellent at your job and still be in the wrong environment. Those two things are not in conflict. Autistic adults are often brilliant at the work itself. It's everything around the work, the unpredictability, the social navigation, the sensory load, the unspoken rules, that quietly drains the system. Performance and sustainability are not the same thing.
comment: A useful distinction here is between ability and fit. Perhaps workplaces need to measure not just what people can produce, but what hidden costs they demand to sustain that output.
